# HOLE (fixed): the shipped template, copied and given prose, passed

- type: Pattern
- domain: <product domain, e.g. legal case management>
- user: <user type, e.g. solo-practitioner lawyer>
- platform: desktop
- problem: <the interaction problem this addresses, in one line>
- confidence: medium
- outcome: unknown
- source: <where this was observed — a run, a receipt id, a route, a cited product>

## Principle

Real prose written by a real author, comfortably past the minimum word count the gate requires,
because the point of this fixture is that the PROSE was never the problem.

## Do not copy

More real prose past the minimum word count. Four of the eight tags above ship pre-filled with
valid values and the other four are placeholders, so every other check passed and an untagged
observation entered the library by copy-paste rather than by attack.
